params.name: disc_rate
params.description: Discount rate used to annualise one-off costs
params.note: Placeholder. Set per DPHE or WaterAid appraisal guidance.

params.name: infl_rate
params.description: Annual cost escalation to bring older BoQ prices to the base year
params.note: Placeholder. Replace with construction cost index trend.

params.name: price_base_year
params.description: Year all costs are expressed in

params.name: cost_case
params.description: Which cost to use from each low-high range
params.note: Switch to see the plan under low or high costs.

params.name: hh_size
params.description: Average household size, used when a town has no stated household count
params.note: Median of 20,179 households in the 50-town survey (q2.7.1 + q2.7.2). The mean is distorted by entry errors up to 1,647.

params.name: hh_basis
params.note: stated = households stated in the SFD report where given, otherwise population / hh_size. hh_size = always population / hh_size. Kaliakair: 68,163 stated against 55,485 at hh_size 5.
